propositions: Extract bridge orchestration from provider-specific workflows into a runner-neutral Python core packaged in the wheel, exposing it through Python library (rebar.bridge_run), CLI (rebar bridge run --profile), and MCP tool interfaces.

Map five profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) to canonical rebar commands while preserving legacy MODE environment variable and benign reconcile results (3/4/75) for direct callers.
Validate wheel availability from all three install paths (pip, Homebrew wheel-backed, MCP Registry/uvx) and ensure no repository-local runner script is required.

Migrate GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and GitLab workflows to invoke installed CLI entrypoint rebar bridge run instead of inline orchestration; validate provider schemas and embedded shell against pinned ShellCheck.
Preserve legacy reconcile compatibility for checked-out workflows while translating benign results to canonical success (0) only in the new provider runner path.
